name: How can I evaluate the effectiveness of an AI SEO strategy for my pediatric practice?

mainEntity.name: How can I evaluate the effectiveness of an AI SEO strategy for my pediatric practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can evaluate the effectiveness of an AI SEO strategy by monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) regularly. These often include increases in organic website traffic, higher search engine rankings for target keywords, improved local search visibility, and a rise in new patient inquiries or appointments originating from online searches. Detailed reports from your AI SEO provider, which should show data-driven insights and progress against established goals, are also essential for assessing success.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evaluate AI SEO effectiveness by monitoring KPIs like organic traffic, search rankings, local visibility, and new patient inquiries, along with detailed reports from your provider.
